stem.en: Which everyday object shows the shape of a circle?

whyWrong.en: A notebook page has 4 straight sides and 4 corners, so it is a rectangle.
A chessboard tile has 4 straight equal sides.

explanation.en: A coin has one round curved edge and no corners.

stem.en: A classroom door usually has the shape of a rectangle.

explanation.en: A door has 4 straight sides with opposite sides equal and 4 corners.

stem.en: How many straight sides and corners does a slice of sandwich shaped like a triangle have?

whyWrong.en: 4 sides and 4 corners belong to a square or rectangle.

explanation.en: Every triangle has 3 straight sides and 3 corners.

stem.en: If all 4 straight sides of a biscuit are the exact same length and it has 4 corners, what shape is it?

whyWrong.en: A circle has no straight sides.

explanation.en: A shape with 4 equal sides and 4 square corners is a square.

stem.en: Every shape with 4 corners has all 4 sides equal.

explanation.en: A rectangle also has 4 corners, even when two sides are longer than the other two.

stem.en: Which flat shape do you get when you trace around the bottom of a cylindrical steel tumbler?

whyWrong.en: A tumbler rim is round, not 3-sided.
A steel tumbler base has a curved edge.

explanation.en: The circular base of a round tumbler traces a circle.

stem.en: How is a rectangle different from a triangle?

text.en: A rectangle has 4 sides and 4 corners, while a triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners

whyWrong.en: Both shapes are made of straight sides.

text.en: A triangle has more corners than a rectangle

explanation.en: Rectangles have 4 sides; triangles have 3 sides.

stem.en: Tracing one flat face of a wooden dice gives a square.

explanation.en: All 6 faces of a standard cube dice are identical squares.

stem.en: Which traffic sign board commonly uses a triangle shape?

text.en: Give Way / School Ahead warning board

explanation.en: Road warning signs often use a bright 3-sided triangle.

stem.en: Meera traces two shapes: one has 0 corners and the other has 4 equal sides. Which pair did she trace?

whyWrong.en: Both a triangle and a rectangle have sharp corners.

explanation.en: A circle has 0 corners, and a square has 4 equal sides.
